en.title: Lamp Illumination Count
en.description:
Each lamp lights the closed interval [l,r]; for each position p, count the lamps satisfying l≤p≤r.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and any ranges or guarantees marked "site-added" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided these limits.
en.input: n,q (1≤n,q≤200000), followed by n lines of l,r (−10⁹..10⁹, l≤r), then q positions p. The ranges are site-added.
en.output: Output the coverage count of each position, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
